newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese bonds end firmer in line with Europe.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese bonds end firmer in line with Europe.

text.p: Portuguese bonds ended firmer in cautious trade and dealers predicted that spreads over Bunds would diminish only if peripheral markets extend gains tomorrow.
"The market closed slightly higher in line with Europe, but trade is very cautious amid continuing worries over the timing of the launch of EMU," said one dealer.
Another said: "The market will accompany the peripherals tomorrow, but spreads against 10-year Bunds will only shorten if peripherals extend gains."
The escudo traded in a narrow range against the mark throughout the session and closed at 100.25/28 per mark, dealers said.
